questions.stem: Claude keeps calling `search_orders` when it should call `get_order_by_id`. What is the most effective first fix?

options.text: Rewrite both tool descriptions to state exactly when each should be used.
Fine-tune a model on correct tool choices.

questions.explanation: Tool selection is driven by descriptions. Clarifying the boundary is cheap and effective.

whyWrong.B: Heavyweight and unnecessary before fixing descriptions.
whyWrong.C: Removes a capability users may need.

questions.mindset: Fix the interface before reaching for heavier tools.

questions.stem: Which input schema detail most reduces malformed tool calls for a date parameter?

options.text: Describing the expected format (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-03-01) in the parameter description.
Accepting any string and parsing loosely.

questions.explanation: Explicit formats with examples guide the model to produce valid inputs.

questions.stem: A team wants one shared MCP server for 200 employees' assistants. Which transport fits?

options.text: Streamable HTTP hosted centrally with authentication.
Copying the server code into each prompt.

questions.explanation: A remote, shared server needs a network transport with auth.

whyWrong.A: stdio is for local subprocesses, not a shared service.

questions.mindset: Match the transport to where the server lives.

questions.stem: In MCP, which component holds the connection to a single server?
questions.explanation: Each client maintains a one-to-one connection with a server; the host can run many clients.

whyWrong.A: The host contains clients but is not itself the connection.
whyWrong.C: Resources are data a server exposes.
whyWrong.D: Prompts are templates a server exposes.

questions.stem: Which THREE primitives can an MCP server expose?
questions.explanation: Servers expose tools, resources and prompts.

whyWrong.D: MCP does not serve model weights.

questions.stem: A tool returns a 5 MB JSON blob, and answers degrade afterwards. What should you change?

options.text: Return only the fields the model needs, with pagination for the rest.
Ask the model to ignore irrelevant fields.

questions.explanation: Tool outputs consume context. Trim and paginate at the source.

whyWrong.C: Output length is unrelated to bloated input.

questions.mindset: Tool results are context; budget them.
